questions.question: Who has been appointed as Lebanon's new Prime Minister after being nominated by two-thirds of the 128 members of parliament? (January 2024)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Nawaf Salam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Nawaf Salam** has been appointed as Lebanon's new Prime Minister, following a nomination by two-thirds of the Lebanese parliament members.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Salam** is the **president of the International Court of Justice (ICJ)** and is a prominent figure in Lebanese politics, coming from a notable Sunni Muslim family in Beirut.
 
• **Hezbollah**, which had hoped to reappoint **caretaker PM Najib Mikati**, refrained from nominating a candidate, signaling a rift within the political landscape. **Salam's nomination is seen as a setback for Hezbollah**.
 
• Salam's appointment followed **Lebanon's recent 13-month conflict with Israel**, in which **Hezbollah's power was significantly weakened**. This left the political party in a less influential position in the parliament.
 
• **Lebanon’s sectarian power-sharing system** reserves the position of Prime Minister for a Sunni Muslim. **Salam, at 71**, is the first Lebanese to hold the ICJ president's post.
 
• In his career, Salam has had notable international roles, including serving as Lebanon's representative to the United Nations and as a judge at the ICJ.
 
• **Salam’s academic background** includes degrees from **Sciences Po University** in France, the **Sorbonne**, and **Harvard Law School**.
 
• Following the election of **Joseph Aoun** as President, Salam’s appointment is seen as a potential **boost for Lebanon’s reconstruction and economic recovery**, with hopes of attracting international support.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Director General of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) in January 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gyanendra Pratap Singh**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Gyanendra Pratap Singh has been appointed as the Director General (DG) of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF). He assumed charge on January 30, 2025, succeeding Vitul Kumar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Career and Background**: A distinguished 1991-batch IPS officer from the Assam-Meghalaya cadre.
 
• **Key Positions: **Held various roles, including DIG and IGP of Assam Police, and Director of the Anti-Corruption Bureau.
 
• **Service Recognition:** Known for contributions to counter-insurgency operations and law enforcement reforms.
 
• **Major Roles**: Led the Anti-Rhino Poaching Task Force and served as DGP of Assam.
 
• **Current Role:** Appointed as the Director General of CRPF on January 30, 2025.
 
• **Tenure:** Will serve as DG of CRPF until retirement on November 30, 2027.

questions.question: Who succeeded S. Somanath as the Chairman of ISRO starting January 14, 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**V. Narayanan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **V. Narayanan took over as the Chairman of ISRO on January 14, 2025, succeeding S. Somanath.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Narayanan is a noted rocket and spacecraft propulsion expert.**
 
• He has been heading ISRO’s Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC) since January 2018.
 
• His tenure as Chairman will include overseeing significant projects like Gaganyaan and Chandrayaan-4 missions.
 
• **He will also assume the role of Secretary, Department of Space, and Chairman of the Space Commission, effective from January 14, 2025.**
 
• He worked on Solid Propulsion for Rockets, ASLV, and PSLV at Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre. 
 
• **Current Role: Director of LPSC , headquartered in Valiamala (Thiruvananthapuram).**
 
• Dr. Narayanan termed his upcoming role as “a great responsibility” and an “opportunity to follow in the footsteps of ISRO stalwarts.”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Gaganyaan Mission__

 __
 
• A human spaceflight mission by ISRO aiming to send Indian astronauts into space.
 
 
 
• Chandrayaan-4 Mission__
 
 
• A planned mission to explore the Moon, focusing on landing and collecting lunar data.

questions.question: Who is set to take oath as the Chief Minister of Delhi after winning the Shalimar Bagh seat in the recent Assembly election?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rekha Gupta**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Rekha Gupta to take oath as Delhi’s 4th woman Chief Minister**, marking BJP’s return to power in Delhi after **27 years**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Won Shalimar Bagh seat by over 29,000 votes**, defeating AAP’s Bandana Kumari in the **February 5 Delhi Assembly elections**.
 
• **Oath ceremony at Ramlila Maidan** attended by **PM Modi, BJP leaders, and former CMs Arvind Kejriwal & Atishi**.
 
• **Council of Ministers includes Parvesh Verma, Ashish Sood, Pankaj Singh, Manjinder Singh Sirsa, Kapil Mishra, and Ravinder Indraj**.
 
• **Gupta, a former DUSU president & municipal councillor**, was chosen as BJP’s legislative party leader on Wednesday.
 
• **She emphasized transparency**, stating that the **previous government must account for every rupee spent**.
 
• **Lt. Governor VK Saxena invited her to form the government after she staked her claim at Raj Niwas**.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) of India in February 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gyanesh Kumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Gyanesh Kumar has been appointed as the new Chief Election Commissioner, replacing Rajiv Kumar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gyanesh Kumar is a 1988-batch IAS officer from the Kerala cadre, and he replaces Rajiv Kumar as the Chief Election Commissioner.**
 
• The appointment was made following a selection process involving Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other senior leaders.
 
• This is the first appointment of the CEC under the Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioner Act, 2023.
 
• Gyanesh Kumar's appointment follows the retirement of Rajiv Kumar, who led the Commission from May 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Chief Election Commissioner (CEC)__

 __
 
• The CEC is the head of the Election Commission of India, overseeing the administration and conduct of elections in the country.
 
• The CEC is appointed for a fixed tenure and plays a crucial role in ensuring free and fair elections.
 
 
 
• Election Commissioner__
 __
 
• Election Commissioners work alongside the CEC and help manage the electoral process, with a focus on policy, planning, and execution.
 
• The Election Commission is a constitutional body tasked with administering elections in India at the central and state levels.
 
 
 
• Rajiv Kumar__
 __
 
• Rajiv Kumar served as the 25th CEC and oversaw key elections including the 2024 Lok Sabha elections.
 
• He was credited for implementing reforms and ensuring peaceful elections during his tenure.
 
 
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioner Act, 2023__
 
 
• This Act outlines the process of appointing and managing Election Commissioners and the CEC, ensuring an independent and impartial electoral body.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://ddnews.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Gyanesh-kumar-1.jpg]

questions.question: Who will assume office as the 7th Secretary-General of the Commonwealth?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Shirley Botchwey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Shirley Botchwey becomes 1st African woman to assume office as Commonwealth Secretary-General.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Shirley Botchwey** has been appointed as the **7th Secretary-General of the Commonwealth**, marking a historic moment as she becomes the **first woman from Africa** to hold the office.

 
 
• 
 
Shirley brings **20 years of leadership experience** in **diplomacy, international relations, governance, and public service**.

 
 
• 
 
She previously served as **Ghana’s Minister for Foreign Affairs and Regional Integration** from **January 2017 to January 2024** and was a member of **Ghana’s National Security Council**.

 
 
• 
 
The Commonwealth Secretary-General can serve a maximum of **two terms** of **four years each**.

 
 
• 
 
The role of the Secretary-General includes **promoting and protecting the Commonwealth’s values** and **managing the Commonwealth Secretariat**.

questions.question: Who took oath as the Chief Justice of Patna High Court in September 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Pavankumar Bhimappa Bajanthri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Justice Pavankumar Bhimappa Bajanthri took oath as the Chief Justice of Patna High Court at Raj Bhavan, Patna.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The oath was administered by Bihar Governor Arif Mohammad Khan in the presence of Bihar CM Nitish Kumar, Deputy CM Samrat Choudhary, and other dignitaries.**
 
• **Justice Bajanthri has vast judicial experience and has previously served in other High Courts, contributing to judicial reforms and key constitutional matters.**
 
• **His appointment is a part of ongoing judicial reshuffles by the Supreme Court Collegium and the Government of India to strengthen leadership in High Courts.**
 
• **As Chief Justice, he will oversee case management, judicial reforms, and strengthening the Patna High Court, which is one of India's oldest High Courts.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Patna High Court Overview**__

 __
 
• The Patna High Court was established and formally opened on February 3, 1916, by the then Viceroy of India, Sir Charles Hardinge, with work commencing on March 1, 1916, though its foundation stone was laid in 1913. It began functioning under the Government of India Act 1915, becoming a significant judicial body for the region. 
 
• Inaugurated by: Lord Hardinge, the Governor-General and Viceroy of India
 
• Jurisdiction: Entire state of Bihar
 
• Significance: Known for landmark rulings in constitutional, criminal, and socio-economic matters
 
 
 
• **Background on the Appointment**__
 
 
• Justice Bajanthri's appointment is crucial for addressing pending cases and improving judicial infrastructure in Bihar.
 
• This is part of a wider judicial reform process following the Supreme Court Collegium’s recommendations.

questions.question: Justice Surya Kant has been recommended to become the 53rd Chief Justice of India (CJI). What is significant about his state of origin?

options.text: He is the first CJI from Uttar Pradesh
He is the first CJI from Haryana
He is the first CJI from Maharashtra
He is the first CJI from Kerala

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**He is the first CJI from Haryana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Justice Surya Kant has been recommended to become the 53rd Chief Justice of India (CJI), following the retirement of CJI Bhushan R Gavai on November 23, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice Surya Kant will be the first CJI from Haryana, marking a significant milestone in India's judicial history.**
 
• **He will assume office immediately after the retirement of Chief Justice Bhushan R Gavai on November 23, 2025, and serve until February 9, 2027.**
 
• **Justice Kant has been a strong proponent of constitutional law, social justice, and human rights, with his background as Chief Justice of Himachal Pradesh High Court.**
 
• **His leadership is expected to focus on enhancing access to justice, digital transformation, and the timely disposal of cases.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Justice Surya Kant__

 __
 
• Born: February 10, 1962
 
• Elevated to the Supreme Court in May 2019
 
• Known for his contributions to constitutional law and human rights
 
 
 
• CJI Gavai’s Endorsement__
 __
 
• CJI Gavai praised Justice Kant as “suited and competent” to lead the judiciary, with a shared understanding of grassroots justice and human rights.
 
• Gavai highlighted Justice Kant's deep understanding of the struggles faced by socially disadvantaged classes.
 
 
 
• Significance of Appointment__
 
 
• Ensures continuity in judicial administration based on seniority.
 
• Justice Kant’s leadership is expected to focus on enhancing access to justice and digital transformation in the judiciary.
 
• His appointment represents a step towards more inclusive representation in the judiciary.

questions.question: Who has been sworn in as the 25th Governor of Mizoram? (Jan 2025)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **V K Singh**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Gen (Retd) VK Singh**, former Army Chief, was sworn in as the **25th Governor of Mizoram** on Thursday, succeeding Hari Babu Kambhampati, now appointed as Odisha Governor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **oath of office and secrecy** was administered by Gauhati High Court Chief Justice **Vijay Bishnoi** at Raj Bhawan, Aizawl.
 
• The ceremony was attended by dignitaries, including Mizoram Chief Minister **Lalduhoma**, former CMs **Zoramthanga** and **Lal Thanhawla**, and Assembly Speaker **Lalbiakzama**.
 
• Singh served as the **24th Chief of the Army Staff (COAS)** from 2010 to 2012 and was the first Indian Army Chief to take legal action against the Centre over a **dispute on his date of birth**.
 
• Post-retirement, he joined the **BJP in 2014**, became a Member of Parliament from **Ghaziabad**, and held ministerial roles, including **Minister of State for Road Transport and Highways** and **Minister of State for External Affairs**.
 
• Mizoram shares **722 kilometers of international borders** with Bangladesh (west) and Myanmar (east and south) and has inter-state borders with Assam, Manipur, and Tripura.

questions.question: Who is the new Lieutenant Governor of Ladakh? (July 2025)
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Kavinder Gupta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__

**President Droupadi Murmu** appointed **new Governors** and **LG.**

 
 
•

• 
 
He is a **former Civil Aviation Minister**.

 
 
 
 
•
